gadgets.name: Jet Boots
gadgets.desc: Blast off with Newton's Third Law. Gives a second chance on wrong answers.

gadgets.name: Gravity Belt
gadgets.desc: Manipulate gravity to reduce boss damage by 50% for one turn.

gadgets.desc: A barrier of pure light. Blocks all boss damage for one attack.

gadgets.name: Laser Compass
gadgets.desc: Highlights the correct answer with a faint glow. Use wisely!

gadgets.name: Rocket Pack
gadgets.desc: Double XP earned for the next 3 questions.

gadgets.name: Quantum Scanner
gadgets.desc: Eliminates two wrong options in MCQ questions.

gadgets.name: Magnetic Gloves
gadgets.desc: Attract bonus coins. +50% coin reward for the next level.

gadgets.name: Electric Hammer
gadgets.desc: Deal double damage to the boss on your next correct answer.

gadgets.name: Time Stabilizer
gadgets.desc: Pauses the timer on timed questions for 30 seconds.
